## Before acting

- Start–end minutes correct, no overlaps, all blocks within available slots and outside obligations.
- Study plus buffer <= usable minutes.
- Each dated task has work before deadline; record any remaining coverage gap.
- Recall/practice/review present; missing types explicitly flagged.
- Quiz questions trace to supplied facts and fit an existing block (no extra five-day plan).
- Unknown dates/workloads remain unknown; update totals after changing any block.
